pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

3. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

5. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 18
   C. 13
   D. 6

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 17

7. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

8. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 27

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
